FAIR HOUSING MODEL RESIDENTIAL LEASE

This Agreement is entered into on June 1, 2026, between Fair Housing Corp ("Landlord") and John Doe ("Tenant") for the premises located at 500 Market Street, Apt 2A.

SECTION 1: LEASE TERM
The term commences on August 1, 2026, and expires on July 31, 2027. Either party may elect not to renew by providing written notice at least thirty (30) days prior to lease expiration.

SECTION 2: RENT AND GRACE PERIOD
Monthly rent is $1,500.00, payable on the first day of each month. A five (5) day grace period applies. If rent is received after the 5th day, a reasonable flat late fee of $25.00 shall apply.

SECTION 3: SECURITY DEPOSIT
Tenant shall deposit $1,500.00 as a security deposit. The entire deposit is 100% refundable within twenty-one (21) days of vacancy, less legitimate documented costs for damages exceeding ordinary wear and tear, accompanied by an itemized statement.

SECTION 4: LANDLORD ENTRY
Landlord shall provide at least twenty-four (24) hours advance written notice prior to entering the premises for maintenance or scheduled inspections, and entries shall take place only during standard business hours (9:00 AM - 5:00 PM), except in cases of immediate emergency threatening life or property.

SECTION 5: MAINTENANCE RESPONSIBILITY
Landlord shall promptly repair and maintain in good working order all electrical, plumbing, heating, air conditioning, and sanitary facilities, as required by municipal habitability codes. Tenant is responsible only for keeping the unit clean and reporting defects.

SECTION 6: TERMINATION & DISPUTE RESOLUTION
In the event of an alleged breach, both parties are entitled to fourteen (14) days written notice to cure. Both parties retain all statutory rights and remedies under applicable state and local landlord-tenant law.
